senses.en: a tool used to make something sharper, such as a pencil sharpener

example.en: I borrowed a pencil sharpener before the exam.
example.zh: 考试前我借了一个卷笔刀。

senses.en: to make or become rough

example.en: Sand the wood first to roughen the surface before painting.
example.zh: 刷漆前先用砂纸打磨木材使表面变粗糙。

senses.en: to try to make someone less angry by pleasing them

example.en: They offered a sacrifice to propitiate the angry god.
example.zh: 他们献上祭品来安抚愤怒的神。

senses.en: sexually attracted to people of the same sex

example.en: The study surveyed attitudes toward homosexual relationships.
example.zh: 该研究调查了人们对同性恋关系的态度。

senses.en: a person who is attracted to people of the same sex

example.en: The law protects homosexuals from discrimination at work.
example.zh: 该法律保护同性恋者免受职场歧视。

senses.en: a person or group whose job is to protect an important person

example.en: The singer was surrounded by bodyguards at the airport.
example.zh: 那位歌手在机场被保镖们簇拥着。

senses.en: relating to a college or college students

example.en: She wore a collegiate jacket with the school logo.
example.zh: 她穿着一件带有校徽的学院风夹克。

senses.en: a person, especially in the 1960s, who rejected conventional society and favored a free, peaceful lifestyle

example.en: In the 1960s many hippies gathered at music festivals.
example.zh: 20世纪60年代许多嬉皮士聚集在音乐节上。

senses.en: hard reddish-brown wood used for making furniture

example.en: The desk is made of solid mahogany.
example.zh: 这张书桌由实心桃花心木制成。

senses.en: a tropical tree that produces this wood

example.en: Mahoganies grow widely in tropical forests.
example.zh: 桃花心木树广泛生长于热带森林。

senses.en: to fail to notice or consider something

example.en: I overlooked a small error in the report.
example.zh: 我忽略了报告中的一个小错误。

senses.en: to have a view of something from above

example.en: Our hotel room overlooks the harbor.
example.zh: 我们的酒店房间俯瞰港口。

senses.en: to forgive or ignore someone's mistake or fault

example.en: She agreed to overlook his late arrival.
example.zh: 她同意不追究他迟到的事。

senses.en: gossip or unverified information passed from person to person

example.en: A rumour about the changes spread through the office.
example.zh: 关于这些变化的传闻在办公室里传开了。

senses.en: to spread reports that may not be true (usually passive)

example.en: The old castle is rumoured to be haunted.
example.zh: 据说那座古堡闹鬼。

senses.en: foolish; not sensible

example.en: It was silly of me to forget my keys.
example.zh: 我忘了带钥匙，真是太傻了。

senses.en: playful and not serious; amusing in a childish way

example.en: The kids were being silly and laughing at their own jokes.
example.zh: 孩子们在扮傻逗乐，为自己的笑话哈哈大笑。

senses.en: a series of images and feelings experienced during sleep

example.en: I had a strange dream last night.
example.zh: 我昨晚做了一个奇怪的梦。

senses.en: a strong hope or aim for the future

example.en: Her dream is to become a doctor.
example.zh: 她的梦想是成为一名医生。

senses.en: to experience images and events while sleeping

example.en: I dreamed that I was late for work.
example.zh: 我梦见自己上班迟到了。

senses.en: to say that something is not true

example.en: She denied taking the money.
example.zh: 她否认拿了那笔钱。

senses.en: to refuse to give or allow something

example.en: The company denied him access to the files.
example.zh: 公司拒绝让他查阅那些文件。

senses.en: the act or process of moving, or a movement from one place or position to another

example.en: The gentle motion of the boat made her sleepy.
example.zh: 船轻轻的晃动让她困了。

senses.en: a formal suggestion made at a meeting for people to discuss and vote on

example.en: The committee approved a motion to change the meeting time.
example.zh: 委员会通过了一项更改会议时间的动议。

senses.en: to make a movement, especially with your hand, to show someone what to do

example.en: He motioned for me to wait outside.
example.zh: 他示意我在外面等。

senses.en: a popular style of clothes, appearance, or behavior at a particular time

example.en: Short skirts are back in fashion this summer.
example.zh: 短裙今年夏天又流行起来了。

senses.en: a way of doing something

example.en: He solved the problem in a practical fashion.
example.zh: 他以务实的方式解决了问题。

senses.en: to make or shape something from materials

example.en: She fashioned a bowl from clay.
example.zh: 她用黏土做了一只碗。

senses.en: something that is more important than other things and should be dealt with first

example.en: Safety is our top priority.
example.zh: 安全是我们的首要任务。

senses.en: the right to be treated first or before others

example.en: The city gives priority to public transport.
example.zh: 这座城市优先考虑公共交通。

senses.en: Most important or main.

example.en: She played the leading role in the school play.
example.zh: 她在学校戏剧中担任主角。

senses.en: Ahead of others in a competition or race.

example.en: She is the leading candidate for the job.
example.zh: 她是这份工作的头号候选人。

senses.en: covered with or full of grass

example.en: We had a picnic on the grassy hillside.
example.zh: 我们在长满草的山坡上野餐。

senses.en: demanding attention or a reply repeatedly and firmly

example.en: He was insistent that we leave at once.
example.zh: 他坚持要我们立刻出发。

senses.en: continuing in a noticeable or repeated way

example.en: There was an insistent knocking on the door.
example.zh: 门上响起了持续不断的敲门声。

senses.en: a unit for measuring dry goods, equal to 4 pecks (about 35 liters)

example.en: The farm sold a thousand bushels of wheat this year.
example.zh: 这家农场今年卖出了一千蒲式耳小麦。

senses.en: fairness; the quality of being just and impartial

example.en: The new policy aims to promote equity in education for all students.
example.zh: 新政策旨在促进所有学生教育方面的公平。

senses.en: the value of a property or business after debts are subtracted; shareholders' ownership interest
senses.zh: （资产减去负债后的）净值；股权；权益

example.en: They built up equity in their home by paying down the mortgage over many years.
example.zh: 他们多年来通过偿还抵押贷款逐步积累了房屋净值。

senses.en: a game played on ice in which two teams try to hit a puck into the opponent's goal

example.en: He plays hockey every winter with his friends.
example.zh: 他每年冬天都和朋友们打冰球。

senses.en: a field game in which two teams try to hit a ball into the opponent's net with curved sticks

example.en: She practices field hockey at school.
example.zh: 她在学校练曲棍球。

senses.en: an extinct reptile that lived millions of years ago

example.en: The museum has a complete dinosaur skeleton on display.
example.zh: 博物馆展出了一具完整的恐龙骨架。

senses.en: someone or something that is outdated and unable to adapt
senses.zh: 过时的人（或事物）；守旧者

example.en: He called the old computer system a dinosaur.
example.zh: 他把那套旧电脑系统称为“老古董”。

senses.en: the return to popularity or activity of something

example.en: The city is enjoying a revival of its old theaters.
example.zh: 这座城市的老剧院正在复兴。

senses.en: a new performance of an old play or show

example.en: The revival of the musical sold out quickly.
example.zh: 那部音乐剧的重演门票很快售罄。

collocations: a revival of a classic play

senses.en: great commitment and hard work for a cause

example.en: Her dedication to teaching impressed everyone.
example.zh: 她对教学的奉献精神令所有人印象深刻。

senses.en: a ceremony to open or devote something to a purpose; a note in a book thanking someone

example.en: The dedication of the new library drew a large crowd.
example.zh: 新图书馆的落成典礼吸引了很多人。

senses.en: a large painting done directly on a wall

example.en: A colorful mural covers the side of the building.
example.zh: 一幅色彩鲜艳的壁画覆盖着大楼的一侧。

senses.en: a respectful way to address a man, especially a stranger or customer
senses.zh: 先生；阁下（对男子的尊称）

example.en: Excuse me, sir, you dropped your wallet.
example.zh: 先生，您的钱包掉了。

senses.en: a title used before the first name of a knight or baronet in the UK
senses.zh: 爵士（英国用于骑士或准男爵名字前的称号）

example.en: Sir Paul McCartney is a famous musician.
example.zh: 保罗·麦卡特尼爵士是一位著名的音乐家。

senses.en: the central business area of a city or town

example.en: The city has a lively downtown.
example.zh: 这座城市有一个热闹的市中心。

senses.en: to or in the central part of a city

example.en: She takes the bus downtown every morning.
example.zh: 她每天早上乘公交车去市中心。

senses.en: located in or typical of the central business district

example.en: They opened a small office in a downtown building.
example.zh: 他们在市中心的一栋楼里开了一间小办公室。

senses.en: the medical work and study of teeth and the mouth

example.en: He studied dentistry at university.
example.zh: 他在大学学习牙科。

senses.en: wearing a mask or with the face covered

example.en: The masked dancers performed at the festival.
example.zh: 蒙面的舞者在节庆上表演。

senses.en: hidden or disguised; not immediately apparent

example.en: He expressed masked anger beneath his polite smile.
example.zh: 他礼貌的笑容下藏着掩饰的怒气。

senses.en: impossible to forget; very memorable

example.en: The trip was an unforgettable experience.
example.zh: 这次旅行是一次难忘的经历。

senses.en: able to be taken off or taken away

example.en: This jacket has a removable hood.
example.zh: 这件夹克有一个可拆卸的兜帽。

senses.en: a tall round structure used for storing grain or animal feed on farms

example.en: The farmer filled the silo with grain.
example.zh: 农民把筒仓装满了谷物。

senses.en: an underground structure that stores and launches missiles

example.en: The missile was kept in a reinforced silo.
example.zh: 导弹存放在加固的发射井里。

senses.en: matching in size, amount, or degree

example.en: Her salary should be commensurate with her experience.
example.zh: 她的薪水应与她的经验相称。

senses.en: a system of connected computers, people, or organizations

example.en: The company's computer network went down this morning.
example.zh: 公司的计算机网络今天早上瘫痪了。

senses.en: a group of television or radio stations that broadcast the same programs

example.en: The interview will air on a national television network.
example.zh: 这次采访将在一个全国性电视网播出。

senses.en: to connect computers or devices so they can share information

example.en: We networked the office computers so files could be shared.
example.zh: 我们把办公室的电脑联网，以便共享文件。

senses.en: to meet people and build professional contacts

example.en: She spent the afternoon networking with potential clients.
example.zh: 她花了一下午与潜在客户建立联系。

senses.en: to work together with others toward a shared goal

example.en: The two teams cooperated to finish the project on time.
example.zh: 两个团队合作按时完成了项目。

senses.en: to do what someone asks or help them willingly

example.en: The witness agreed to cooperate with the investigation.
example.zh: 证人同意配合调查。

senses.en: a tube-shaped food made of minced meat and spices in a thin skin

example.en: We grilled sausages for lunch.
example.zh: 我们午餐烤了香肠。

senses.en: used informally to address someone affectionately, especially in British English
senses.zh: （英式英语非正式）小傻瓜，小可爱

example.en: Don't worry, you silly sausage.
example.zh: 别担心，你这个小傻瓜。

senses.en: a container, often tall and decorative, used to hold flowers or as an ornament

example.en: She put the roses in a glass vase.
example.zh: 她把玫瑰插进了一个玻璃花瓶里。

senses.en: the coldest season of the year, between autumn and spring

example.en: We ski every winter.
example.zh: 我们每年冬天都滑雪。

senses.en: to spend the winter in a place

example.en: Many birds winter in the south.
example.zh: 许多鸟在南方过冬。

senses.en: relating to or suitable for winter

example.en: She bought winter boots.
example.zh: 她买了冬靴。

senses.en: a person who tells lies

example.en: He called her a liar in front of everyone.
example.zh: 他当着所有人的面说她是骗子。

senses.en: to make something bigger, or to become bigger

example.en: They plan to enlarge the kitchen by knocking down a wall.
example.zh: 他们计划拆掉一面墙来扩大厨房。

senses.en: to say more about something; to expand on a topic (enlarge on/upon)

example.en: Could you enlarge on your reasons for leaving?
example.zh: 你能详细说明一下离开的原因吗？

senses.en: a large, impressive house

example.en: They bought a mansion in the countryside.
example.zh: 他们在乡下买了一座豪宅。

senses.en: (British English, usually plural Mansions) used in the names of some large apartment buildings
senses.zh: （英式英语，通常用复数 Mansions）公寓大楼（用于楼名）

example.en: She lives in Riverside Mansions.
example.zh: 她住在河滨公寓。

senses.en: to crush or cut something into small pieces or powder by rubbing it against a rough surface or in a machine

example.en: She grinds fresh coffee beans every morning.
example.zh: 她每天早上磨新鲜的咖啡豆。

senses.en: to make a harsh scraping sound, or to scrape two things together

example.en: The car's brakes began to grind loudly.
example.zh: 汽车的刹车开始发出刺耳的摩擦声。

senses.en: a task that is boring and takes a long time (informal)

example.en: Working two jobs every day is a real grind.
example.zh: 每天做两份工作真是件苦差事。

senses.en: a series of short knocking sounds; also a baby's toy that makes noise when shaken

example.en: I heard the rattle of keys at the door.
example.zh: 我听到了门口钥匙的哗啦声。

senses.en: to make or cause a series of short knocking sounds
senses.zh: 发出嘎嘎声；使发出嘎嘎声

example.en: The windows rattled in the strong wind.
example.zh: 窗户在强风中咯咯作响。

senses.en: to make someone nervous or upset

example.en: The loud noise rattled the players during the match.
example.zh: 比赛中巨大的噪音让球员们心神不宁。

senses.en: not awake and not aware of surroundings

example.en: He was unconscious after the accident.
example.zh: 事故后他失去了知觉。

senses.en: not aware of or not deliberately thinking about something

example.en: She made an unconscious gesture with her hand.
example.zh: 她做了一个无意识的手势。

senses.en: (psychology) the part of the mind that a person is not aware of

example.en: Dreams may reveal the unconscious.
example.zh: 梦可能揭示无意识。

senses.en: to pretend to be stronger or more confident than you really are in order to deceive someone

example.en: He bluffed his way through the meeting without knowing the details.
example.zh: 他在不了解细节的情况下虚张声势地应付了会议。

senses.en: a false statement or pretense meant to deceive; also a steep cliff

example.en: His threat was just a bluff.
example.zh: 他的威胁只是虚张声势。

senses.en: direct and outspoken but friendly; or very steep

example.en: She has a bluff, friendly manner.
example.zh: 她为人直率友好。

senses.en: money obtained from an event or sale
senses.zh: 收益；（销售等活动所得的）款项

example.en: The proceeds from the concert will go to charity.
example.zh: 音乐会的收益将捐给慈善机构。

senses.en: absorbent paper used to dry wet ink

example.en: He pressed the blotter over the fresh ink to dry it.
example.zh: 他把吸墨纸压在新写的墨迹上吸干。

senses.en: a daily record of events, especially arrests, at a police station

example.en: Her name appeared in the police blotter.
example.zh: 她的名字出现在警方记事簿上。

senses.en: an unnaturally high voice used above the normal singing range

example.en: He surprised everyone by singing the chorus in falsetto.
example.zh: 他用假声唱副歌，让所有人感到意外。

senses.en: relating to or sounding like falsetto

example.en: The singer hit a falsetto note that amazed the audience.
example.zh: 这位歌手唱出了一个令观众惊叹的假声高音。

senses.en: a large bag for carrying clothes and other items when traveling

example.en: She packed her holdall for the weekend trip.
example.zh: 她收拾好旅行包准备周末出行。

senses.en: the last letter of the Greek alphabet (Ω, ω)
senses.zh: 希腊字母表的最后一个字母（Ω, ω）

example.en: Omega is often used as a symbol in physics.
example.zh: 欧米伽常用作物理学中的符号。

senses.en: the final part or end of something

example.en: The collapse of the company was the omega of his career.
example.zh: 公司的倒闭是他职业生涯的终结。

senses.en: to be or become greater than something else

example.en: Demand for housing has outstripped supply in many cities.
example.zh: 在许多城市，住房需求已经超过了供应。

senses.en: to move faster than someone and pass them

example.en: She easily outstripped the other runners in the final lap.
example.zh: 在最后一圈，她轻松地超过了其他选手。

senses.en: to argue noisily about small unimportant things

example.en: The children squabbled over who would sit by the window.
example.zh: 孩子们为谁坐在窗边而争吵。

senses.en: a petty quarrel

example.en: Their squabble over money lasted only a few minutes.
example.zh: 他们因钱的口角只持续了几分钟。
